description: Returns the caller's most recent orders. Pass role: 'buyer' for orders you placed, or role: 'seller' for orders on your own listings; omit role for both. Each entry has the same decoded status booleans as orders.status (reserved / dispatched / paid / received / rejected / closed), plus the product name, item count, total price (converted to the requested currency, default: your own), the other party's name, and a link to the order page. Read-only, no side effects. Requires a signed-in Resollo user (OAuth sign-in, or an 'Authorization: Bearer <agent api key>' header).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the returned price fields. Same default as in search_products (the caller's own currency, else derived like on the website, else marketplace.info default_currency).

limit.description: Maximum number of most-recent orders to return (1-50, default 20).

role.description: Whose side to list from: 'buyer' returns orders you placed, 'seller' returns orders on your listings. Omit for both, newest first (each entry's role says which side it is).

name: orders.list
title: List the authenticated user's own Resollo orders
